evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued unilaterally, commanding an action without reciprocity or shared framing — a rank-enacting command form.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second bare imperative continuing the same command posture toward the system, no exchange or pooling implied.
